boundaries.name: \Gamma_D
boundaries.description: displacement boundary with zero displacement penalized by beta

boundaries.name: \Gamma_N
boundaries.description: loaded boundary with vertical traction q

expressions.name: k
expressions.formula: k_0 if phi(x) < 0; k_0/1000 if phi(x) >= 0

expressions.name: E
expressions.formula: E_0 if phi(x) < 0; E_0/1000 if phi(x) >= 0

objective.name: J
objective.description: Cost functional for the thermo-elastic problem
terms: \int_{\Gamma_D} \beta (\mathbf{e}_x \cdot \mathbf{u})^2 \, ds : penalty on horizontal displacement on \Gamma_D

state_equation.description: Linear coupled state equations for temperature T and displacement u
state_equation.weak_form_lhs: \left(-\int_{\Gamma_T} \beta_T g_T(x)\delta T\,ds + \int_{\Gamma_T} \beta_T T\delta T\,ds + \int_D k(\nabla T\cdot\nabla\delta T)\,dx\right) + \left(\int_{\Gamma_D} \beta(\mathbf{u}\cdot\delta\mathbf{u})\,ds + \int_{\Gamma_N} q(\mathbf{e}_y\cdot\delta\mathbf{u})\,ds + \int_D \rho g\chi(\mathbf{e}_y\cdot\delta\mathbf{u})\,dx + \int_D(\pmb\sigma(T,\mathbf{u}):\pmb\varepsilon(\delta\mathbf{u})^\top)\,dx\right)

adjoint_equation.weak_form_lhs: \left(\int_{\Gamma_T} \beta_T \delta T \tilde T\,ds + \int_D k(\nabla\delta T\cdot\nabla\tilde T)\,dx + \int_D(\partial_{(T,\delta T)}\pmb\sigma(\delta T):\pmb\varepsilon(\tilde{\mathbf{u}})^\top)\,dx\right) + \left(\partial_{(\mathbf{u},\delta\mathbf{u})}J(\delta\mathbf{u},\mathbf{u}) + \int_{\Gamma_D} \beta(\delta\mathbf{u}\cdot\tilde{\mathbf{u}})\,ds + \int_D(\partial_{(\mathbf{u},\delta\mathbf{u})}\pmb\sigma(\delta\mathbf{u}):\pmb\varepsilon(\tilde{\mathbf{u}})^\top)\,dx\right)
